column1: # Haemoglobin high-altitude adaptation sites — Tier 1 site-level truth set
# Phenotype: altitude in Sino-Himalayan tits (Paridae) + long-tailed tits
# (Aegithalidae). Fixture = validation/fixtures/tier1/hb_altitude/ (16 tips,
# 7 high / 9 low by elevational-range midpoint; three globin genes alphaA / alphaD
# Numbering: mature globin chain, standard Hb convention.
#   alphaA : initiator Met cleaved -> residue 1 = Val. Fixture align/HBA.fasta has
#            the Met stripped, so alignment column N == alphaA residue N (1:1,
#            verified in build.py:_assert_landmarks; no ref row needed).
#   alphaD : N-terminal Met retained -> column N == alphaD residue N.
#   betaA  : initiator Met cleaved -> residue 1 = Val; column N == betaA residue N.
# `gene` column: HBA | HBD | HBB  (== the fixture alignment file stem).
# Evidence tiers (column `tier`):
#   mutagenesis        : function-altering effect on Hb-O2 affinity demonstrated
#                        by site-directed mutagenesis (Zhu 2018 / cited work),
#                        AND the derived state arose independently in >=2 lineages
#   parallel-candidate : residue is high-altitude-private in THIS fixture (carried
#                        by >=2 phylogenetically independent high-altitude tips,
#                        absent from every low-altitude tip) but not individually
#                        functionally tested here. Partly alignment-derived — use
#                        with care, not as a headline precision number.
# Sources: Zhu2018 (PNAS, the fixture's own dataset); Natarajan2015 (PLoS Genet
#   11:e1005681, Andean waterfowl); Natarajan2016 (Science 354:336).
# KNOWN COMPLICATIONS (see fixture README "Known complications"):
#  - alphaA34: Sylviparus modestus (LOW, basal Paridae) also carries Thr34 — this
#    is retention of the ancestral avian state (chicken alphaA is Thr34; the
#    Paridae-crown ancestor is the derived Ala34), NOT the CpG-driven convergent
#    substitution. Machlolophus spilonotus (LOW) carries Ile34. So a clean CAAS
#    call at alphaA34 requires the contrast selector NOT to pair Sylviparus as a
#    background partner. Recovery here is a genuine test, not a gimme.
#  - The Natarajan Andean betaA sites 86, 94, 116 are invariant in this fixture
#    (Zhu 2018) and are deliberately NOT listed — they are neither positives nor
#    scorable here. betaA83 IS variable (Poecile davidi) and is listed.
# TODO: transcribe the full AncParidae -> P. humilis (12 sites) / L. dichrous
#   (6 sites) alphaA substitution lists from Zhu 2018 Fig S3 for a "divergent"
#   tier, before quoting divergent-site recall as a headline fraction.
